originality.rationale: A completed positive broader-coverage comparison settles this, not search absence or source inaccessibility. Ivanov–Tuzhilin 2019 Section 3.3 explicitly supplies the complete fixed-type formula for every six-point metric: the eight vertex expressions for the two-moustache tree and twelve for the three-moustache tree. Its earlier binary-tree/generalized-filling equivalence and minimization over all labeled types give the exact minimal-filling weight for every six-point metric. Substituting the cyclic three-distance metric, and then the constant-curvature chord formulas, is a special-case evaluation of a stronger complete result. The exact compact two-branch simplification and explicit achieving tree may be useful, but the final exact-weight claim is already logically covered by this universal six-point formula under the authoritative rule that a special case is covered even without matching wording or numeric value.
